question: Should this export-only Mattermost refactor receive a proof override, or must the contributor add a live Mattermost smoke before merge?
rationale: The repository requires real behavior proof for external non-docs PRs, but this patch leaves runtime function bodies and production calls unchanged, making a maintainer judgment appropriate on whether live proof is proportionate.

options.title: Grant proof override
options.body: Accept the focused tests, type checks, ratchet checks, and unchanged runtime path as sufficient evidence for this internal cleanup.

options.title: Require live smoke
options.body: Request redacted Mattermost logs or a transcript showing normal message and mention-gating handling on this exact head.

recommendation.title: Grant proof override
recommendation.body: Accept the focused tests, type checks, ratchet checks, and unchanged runtime path as sufficient evidence for this internal cleanup.

likelyOwner.reason: The available merged history ties this person to both the dead-code ratchet and this Mattermost cleanup surface.
